correctness.rationale: All n>=4: Feichtner--Sturmfels flacet criterion gives precisely the asserted facets; tight facets correspond to connected induced vertex sets of each tree. The normal-cone rays contain signed unit vectors for all graph edges, spanning the cocharacter lattice integrally; the toric divisor exact sequence therefore has torsion-free cokernel of the stated rank. Path and star extrema are proved by a distinct-path lower bound and an inductive leaf-deletion upper bound. Exact finite checker separately enumerates n=4,5,6 and confirms facet dimensions for n=4,5; tests are supplementary.

value.rationale: A complete local Weil-divisor class-group classification at every torus-fixed point of a natural infinite family is a geometric invariant, not an arbitrary finite sample. It refines global nonsmoothness and reveals shape-dependent quadratic-to-exponential failure of local Q-factoriality. Standard facet and divisor machinery is acknowledged; the substantive output is its explicit integral, combinatorially indexed evaluation.
